claim: Fleischman said that in the United States organs are being removed from minors and that this is beginning to be done to children as young as three.
discovery_sources: The Seventh Eye 2024 Channel 14 report/PDF; Endocrine Society 2022 patient guidance and clinical-practice guideline; repeated exact-phrase Hebrew/English searches
resolution_notes: The Seventh Eye preserves the quote and attributes it to Fleischman on 'Riklin & Segal'. Credible non-social counter-evidence remains strong: Endocrine Society guidance states U.S. adolescents cannot consent to removal of ovaries/uterus/testes/penis until age 18, and its guideline recommends delaying genital surgery involving gonadectomy/hysterectomy until at least 18/legal majority. This run's exact-phrase and program searches again surfaced only the monitoring report/reposts, not the exact original Channel 14 broadcast date/full segment. Origin/media provenance and surrounding context therefore remain incomplete and no adverse verdict is forced.
media_status: No exact original Channel 14 clip recovered; secondary monitoring capture remains provenance only. No generic/substitute imagery used.
